stories.title: Poland opens terrorism probe into Krakow mass shooting
stories.summary: Prosecutors formally opened an investigation on Sunday and said the attack that killed at least six people in Krakow's historic main square will be treated as a terrorist act. Police say the 24-year-old suspect, who held far-right views, killed three family members before the rampage; Poland began two days of national mourning.

stories.title: Trump says Iran strikes 'highly unlikely' if talks keep progressing
stories.summary: In a CNN phone interview, Trump said renewed US strikes on Iran are 'highly unlikely' while negotiations to end the conflict move forward, though he said it depends on Tehran signing 'a very strong agreement.' Both sides meanwhile reported ships hit in or near the Strait of Hormuz, which remains the choke point squeezing global energy exports.

stories.title: Trump speaks publicly for the first time since Republican midterm losses
stories.summary: The president addressed reporters at the White House after voters delivered a rebuke to Republicans in Tuesday's midterm elections, with Democrats projected to take control of Congress. The remarks come as the administration signals a more confrontational posture, including Stephen Miller moving into the chief of staff role.

stories.title: Israel's president formally tasks Eisenkot with forming a government
stories.summary: President Isaac Herzog handed former military chief Gadi Eisenkot the mandate to build a coalition, after 67 of 120 Knesset members recommended him against 46 for Benjamin Netanyahu. Eisenkot now has 28 days, plus a possible 14-day extension, to assemble a majority and end Netanyahu's run as premier.

stories.title: Weta FX chief: studios now refuse VFX vendors without an AI plan
stories.summary: Weta FX CEO Daniel Seah said studios that banned generative AI in early 2025 now ask vendors about their AI strategy, with the message since the third quarter being 'if you don't have an AI strategy, don't bother to work with us.' The shop builds its own world-modification models rather than chatbot-style LLMs, and is partnering with Taiwan's Moonshine Studio.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs pulls Claude Code access from bankers and traders
stories.summary: Goldman restricted Anthropic's Claude Code and Microsoft's GitHub to its engineers under internal guidance updated in October, cutting off traders and bankers who had used the tools to model markets and track client flows. The bank is simultaneously a lead underwriter on Anthropic's IPO, underscoring how firms are separating engineering use of AI coding agents from front-office risk.

stories.title: Tesla to end Cybertruck production in 2027 after niche sales
stories.summary: Musk said Friday that Tesla will stop building the Cybertruck next year, closing a program that drew about a million reservations but only an estimated 71,000 deliveries since late 2023. It missed both the promised sub-$40,000 price and 500-mile range, and never escaped a niche audience.

stories.title: Shedeur Sanders makes first start of 2026 as Browns sit Deshaun Watson
stories.summary: Cleveland turned to second-year quarterback Shedeur Sanders for Sunday's road game in New Orleans, with Deshaun Watson inactive despite clearing the concussion protocol. Coach Todd Monken's call gives Sanders his first start of the season in a game the 5-3 Browns need to keep pace in the AFC North.

stories.title: Browns head to New Orleans hunting fixes for run defense and turnovers
stories.summary: Cleveland's plan against the Saints centers on stopping the run and protecting the football after a lopsided loss in Pittsburgh. The Browns entered Week 9 at 5-3 and need a road win to stay in the AFC North race.

stories.title: Ohio State's second straight loss leaves season at a breaking point
stories.summary: The Buckeyes fell 41-28 to Oregon at Ohio Stadium, their second consecutive defeat, after leading 14-0 in the first quarter and then surrendering 38 unanswered points. It was the first time Ohio State has given up 38 straight since 1999, and the loss likely ends its College Football Playoff hopes.

stories.title: Inside the offensive collapse that sank Ohio State against Oregon
stories.summary: The Dispatch broke down how Ohio State's offense stalled after its fast start, pointing to execution errors and self-inflicted penalties along the line. Lineman Austin Siereveld said the problems came down to 'getting all on the same page.'

stories.title: Antonelli spins out of the lead days after clinching the title
stories.summary: Newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli lost the lead by spinning in the slippery Interlagos conditions, handing the advantage to Norris. The error cost Mercedes a likely win in the race where it still wrapped up the constructors' championship.

stories.title: Norris wins rainy Sao Paulo Grand Prix from pole
stories.summary: Lando Norris converted pole into victory at Interlagos, finishing 14.6 seconds clear of Max Verstappen, who recovered to second after starting from the back. Isack Hadjar completed the podium in third as wet-dry-wet conditions scrambled the field.

stories.title: Mercedes clinches constructors' title, its first since 2021
stories.summary: Antonelli's season-long haul plus the team's Interlagos result secured Mercedes its first constructors' championship since 2021, ending years of Red Bull dominance. The title is the first for the current Mercedes lineup under the 2026 regulations.

stories.title: Crew lock up No. 7 seed, will face Inter Miami in playoffs
stories.summary: Columbus finished seventh in the Eastern Conference with 47 points after beating Chicago Fire 4-3 in Saturday's regular-season finale. The Crew open a best-of-three first-round series on the road against No. 2 Inter Miami and host Game 2, with dates still to be set.

stories.title: Frost advisory issued for Franklin County into Monday morning
stories.summary: The National Weather Service posted a frost advisory for Franklin County and parts of central Ohio from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. Monday, with lows expected near freezing after a sunny, mild Sunday. It follows a freeze warning that hit parts of the region Sunday morning.
